strategy_roster.name: Blau C-Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: Blau's triple-smoothed momentum is built from ROC(10) smoothed three times with EMA(5) and the documented Breakdown mode becomes a zero-line cross; the docs give no lengths so 10/5/5/5 are stated defaults. The delayed-ROC subtraction term, Twist mode, SignalBar shifting, money management and price-step stops are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: ScalpWiz 9001
strategy_roster.notes: Only the market-derived trigger is kept: a close beyond the Bollinger envelope (period/deviation unspecified, so 20 and 2) during volatility expansion measured against ATR(14) versus its own average, exiting back at the middle band. The four-layer pending-order grid, risk-percent sizing and pip-based stop/target/trailing are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Adaptive HMA Plus
strategy_roster.notes: The adaptive Hull MA cannot be computed here, so a 100-bar SMA (midpoint of the documented MinPeriod 172 / MaxPeriod 233) stands in, and its 5-bar slope direction gives the entry/exit signal. The 0.031 adaptation factor, FlatThreshold activity test, optional volume basis and 5-minute timeframe are approximated by the ATR-activity gate.

strategy_roster.name: CCI Volatility Filter
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so the documented CciPeriod = 20 and CciOversold = -100 map onto a 20-bar z-score below about -1.5 mean deviations, with the volatility filter from AtrPeriod = 14 versus its own average. The ATR-multiple stops, +100 overbought short branch and 5-minute candle type are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Coensio Swing Trader
strategy_roster.notes: The user-defined slope/intercept trendlines (defaulting to a flat zero line) are not computable, so a 20-bar Donchian projection supplies the Close > BuyLine breakout and a lost 20-bar average the documented false-breakout close. EntryThreshold = 15 ticks and the 50/100-tick stop, target and trailing step are price units, so SL/TP stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Symr New Bar
strategy_roster.notes: Documented explicitly as placing no trades: it only detects and logs new-bar boundaries across several timeframes from one subscription. The never-true guard records that there is no market-derived signal to translate.

strategy_roster.name: STLMCandle
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule is purely candle direction: a bullish last candle opens long and a bearish one closes it, which translates directly. StopLoss and TakeProfit are absolute price units rather than percentages, so both fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: ICT Bread and Butter Sell-Setup
strategy_roster.notes: Only the long 'London Close Buy' leg translates: a close below the session low becomes a close below the 20-bar prior low, exiting back inside it. The 10:30-13:00 window, London/NY/Asia session boundaries and 10/20/15-tick stops are time and price-unit features the DSL cannot express.

strategy_roster.name: Spot Futures Arbitrage
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is the price difference between two separate securities (spot versus its futures contract) traded as a spread, which a single-symbol series cannot express. The never-true guard is used instead of inventing a long leg.

strategy_roster.name: Manager Trailing
strategy_roster.notes: A position-management demo that buys once on the first finished candle and then applies trailing and partial closes; it has no market-derived entry condition, and its percentages have no documented values. The never-true guard prevents fabricating a signal.
